title: Wringer agent usage report
description: usage.json, a SIBLING file in a loop bundle. What the coding agent said it spent — its own claim, recorded verbatim and never verified by Wringer. A sibling rather than a field on worker.finished because that event's schema is frozen and closed (law 7), the same reason vacuity.json is a sibling. ABSENT ENTIRELY from every loop whose agent reported nothing: absence means unreported, and must never be read as zero.

reported_by.description: Who produced these numbers. Only ever the agent — Wringer measures wall-clock and iterations, and does not count tokens.

verified.description: Always false. Wringer cannot check an agent's report of its own spending, and a field that could read true would invite the assumption that it had been checked.

rows.description: One row per ACP session that reported — that is, per loop iteration whose agent sent a usage_update. An iteration that reported nothing has no row rather than a zeroed one.

used.description: Context tokens used, as the agent reported them. CUMULATIVE within its session, so a row carries that session's last report rather than a sum of its updates.

size.description: The context window the agent reported having.

cost.description: PRESENT ONLY when the agent reported one. Wringer holds no price table and performs no conversion.

totals.description: Across sessions, which are independent of each other.

used.description: The sum of every row's used figure.

size.description: The largest context window any session reported, not a sum — windows do not add.

cost.description: PRESENT ONLY when every reporting row shares one currency. Mixed currencies produce no total, because adding them would need an exchange rate — a live vendor fact with a shelf life, which this program deliberately does not hold.
